description: This file implements the <field-to-session> element as a class named FieldToSession that extends MethodOperation, used within the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework to transfer a field value to a session attribute.

classes.name: FieldToSession
classes.description: Implements a method operation to transfer a specified field value from the environment map into the session attributes under a specific name within the MiniLang framework.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation by retrieving the specified field value from the environment map and setting it as a session attribute if applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <field-to-session> element.
